title: Maximum Distance Between Unequal Words in Array I
summary: Given an array of strings, determine the greatest distance between two different indices where the strings at these indices are not identical.
statement: Given an array of strings, determine the greatest distance between two different indices where the strings at these indices are not identical. The distance is calculated as the difference between the indices plus one. Return this maximum distance, or 0 if no such pair exists.
constraints: Choose two indices holding different strings.
Their distance is the index difference plus one.
Return the maximum distance, or zero if every pair has equal strings.
hints: Enumerate all index pairs in increasing order.
For each remaining pair compute j-i+1.
The maximum across all eligible pairs is the requested distance.
editorial: The maximum across all eligible pairs is the requested distance.

tests.explanation: Indices zero and two differ, giving distance three.
No pair contains unequal words, so return zero.
